notes.title: Deluxe Version Released!
notes.notes:
You can now purchase the Deluxe version of The Princess' Heart! ːtphsplendoraː
The launch discount of 10% is still running, but it will end in 24 hours, so get your copy fast!

What does the Deluxe version include? A lot of awesome stuff, of course!
The 71-page Strategy Guide (more information here).
The full Original Soundtrack! (2 Discs and 24 Tracks)
3 exclusive skills: [Wind], [Radiant Star] and [Cutesy Claws]
4 exclusive items to aid you in battle: [Firey Tea], [Green Tea], [Jasmine Tea] and [Black Tea]
Two [Scrolls of Return]
Four [Poisonous Liquids], which permanently increase one's Magic Points!

All items are granted to you from the start of the game.

Have fun! ^_-

http://www.roseportalgames.com/images/middle/game_tph/screen11.jpg

http://www.roseportalgames.com/images/middle/game_tph/screen13.jpg
